_comment: What the literature says Adenoviridae encodes, scored against the module
vocabulary by check_literature_gaps.py. Step 2b of the skill: a protein
that is real biology but was never annotated in the genomes we dumped is
INVISIBLE to a build driven by annotation strings. It does not appear as
a gap, as UNASSIGNED, or as a low count -- it simply never appears.
Every PMID here was resolved against PubMed by scripts/pm.py and the
title read before it was written down. None was recalled from memory.
They belong in PMID_claude_generated, never in PMID.
The core 17 are deliberately NOT given citations for their existence --
hexon, penton and fiber are not propositions anyone needs a paper for.
Citations are attached where the probe makes a CLAIM the build acts on:
that a protein exists at all, that a genus has two copies of a gene,
that a precursor is cleaved, or that a product is spliced.

probes.name: E1A
probes.note: The first gene expressed; 13S and 12S mRNAs give the 289R and 243R products by alternative 5' splice site within one transcription unit.

probes.name: E1A 243R
probes.note: The 12S product. 243R is 289R minus an internal 46-residue block (conserved region 3), so the two are ~100% identical outside it. Declared as a SPLICE feature, not a second PSSM, because no profile can separate them.

probes.name: E1B 19K
probes.note: Bcl-2 homologue; blocks E1A-induced apoptosis.

probes.name: E1B 55K
probes.note: p53-SUMO1 E3 ligase; with E4orf6 forms the cullin-based ubiquitin ligase that degrades p53.

probes.name: protein IX
probes.note: Minor capsid protein, the capsid cement sitting in the hexon facets. Present in Mastadenovirus, Aviadenovirus and Atadenovirus; ABSENT in Siadenovirus.

probes.name: core protein V
probes.note: Mastadenovirus-specific core protein; bridges the DNA-pVII core to the capsid. Not present in the other genera.

probes.name: E3 gp19K
probes.note: ER-resident type I membrane glycoprotein that binds MHC class I and retains it in the ER. CARRIES A CLEAVED N-TERMINAL SIGNAL PEPTIDE -- the only signal peptide in the mastadenovirus proteome -- plus a C-terminal ER-retention signal.

probes.name: E3 6.7K
probes.note: Required WITH the RID complex for internalisation and degradation of TRAIL receptor 2. Found by this probe pass, not by the annotation strings.

probes.name: E3 RID-alpha
probes.note: E3 10.4K. With RID-beta removes Fas, EGFR and TNFR1 from the cell surface.

probes.name: E3 RID-beta
probes.note: E3 14.5K, the other half of the RID complex.

probes.name: adenovirus death protein
probes.note: E3 11.6K. Required for efficient lysis and release at the end of infection.

probes.name: E4orf1
probes.note: PI3K-Akt activator; targeted by p53.

probes.name: E4orf3
probes.note: Disrupts PML nuclear bodies and drives the MRN complex into cytoplasmic aggresomes.

probes.name: E4orf5
probes.note: Found as accessory cluster UNC1 in triage pass 1 (59 sequences, median 151 aa, labelled 'Orf5' and 'E4 17 kDa protein'); promoted to a declared feature in pass 2.

probes.name: E4orf6
probes.note: E4 34K. With E1B 55K forms the p53 ubiquitin ligase and stimulates late mRNA nuclear export.

probes.name: E4orf6/7
probes.note: A SPLICED product: exon 1 of orf6 joined to orf7. Two exons, one intron.

probes.name: long fiber
probes.note: The enteric species HAdV-F40 and F41 carry TWO fiber genes, a long and a short. This is the claim that put FIBER1/FIBER2 in the Mastadenovirus module; triage pass 1 had left them in the accessory pool as UNC2 (median 555 aa) and UNC5 (median 368 aa).

probes.name: U exon protein
probes.note: A late l-strand product overlapping E3 antisense; unrecognised until 2007, which is exactly the shape of protein this probe pass exists to catch.

probes.name: VA RNA I/II
probes.note: NOT MODELLED AND NOT A GAP: the VA RNAs are non-coding Pol III transcripts. They have no protein product and cannot carry a PSSM. Recorded here so the absence is a decision rather than an oversight.

probes.name: long fibre
probes.note: FAdV-1 (CELO) carries two fibre genes at one locus; the long and short fibre head domains were solved separately. Not alternative starts -- separate genes.

probes.name: GAM-1
probes.note: CELO anti-apoptotic protein; no mastadenovirus homologue.

probes.name: E1 region
probes.note: ABSENT BY BIOLOGY, NOT BY OVERSIGHT. Aviadenovirus has no E1, no E3 and no E4 region and no protein V. The genus-specific ORFs at both genome ends take their place. Declaring E1A here would make the annotator report it missing on all 447 genomes.

probes.name: protein IX
probes.note: Present in Aviadenovirus per the cement-protein comparison, but deposited rarely. Measure before declaring.

probes.name: ORF22 (pRb-binding)
probes.note: Binds the retinoblastoma protein and activates E2F; the pRb-binding region maps to roughly residues 97-114. CELO 32429-31812, 205 aa. The only CELO accessory ORF with experimentally supported function.

probes.name: ORF16 (ADP-ribosyltransferase)
probes.note: Homology to vertebrate mono-ADP-ribosyltransferases, Pfam PF01129, by CD-Search. CELO 39705-39286, 139 aa. COMPUTATIONAL assignment.

probes.name: ORF12
probes.note: Distantly related to parvovirus NS1/Rep (Pfam PF01057) with an INACTIVE ATPase/helicase domain. CELO 5412-4462, 315 aa. Function in an adenoviral context unresolved -- number kept.

probes.name: ORF13
probes.note: Same inactive NS1/Rep-like family as ORF2 and ORF12. CELO 4568-3549, 339 aa. Number kept.

probes.name: ORF9
probes.note: CELO 40037-41002, 321 aa; transcript shown to be spliced up to 40133, so the amino terminus is unclear. Function unknown -- number kept.

probes.name: ORF10
probes.note: CELO 41002-41853, 283 aa, NO homologues. Translation start likely at 41113. Number kept.

probes.name: ORF11
probes.note: CELO 41958-42365, 135 aa. Function unknown -- number kept.

probes.name: ORF14
probes.note: CELO 3503-2892, 203 aa; amino terminus extended by 43 residues in the reannotation. Number kept.

probes.name: ORF17
probes.note: CELO 39256-38717, 179 aa. Function unknown -- number kept.

probes.name: ORF20
probes.note: CELO 33832-32892, 313 aa; amino terminus extended by 42 residues. Highly conserved across FAdV species but low protein-coding potential by one analysis. Number kept.

probes.name: sialidase (ORF1)
probes.note: Genus-defining gene -- the 'sia' in Siadenovirus. High similarity to BACTERIAL sialidases; confirmed structural component of the TAdV-3 virion. Whether the domain is catalytically active is explicitly open. TAdV-3 NC_001958 399..1952, 517 aa.

probes.name: hyd (hydrophobic protein)
probes.note: Genus-specific. Function UNKNOWN -- named for a property. mRNA uses the tripartite leader and shares a polyA signal with ORF1.

probes.name: E3
probes.note: A single E3 of its own, not the mastadenovirus cassette. NC_001958 21213..22115, 300 aa, but the reference's OWN note says 'identification based on very limited similarity'. No functional study found. Not asserting a function.

probes.name: ORF7
probes.note: One of the five genus-specific genes. NC_001958 24509..25165, 218 aa; the discovered cluster's median is 225 aa. Function UNKNOWN -- keeping the number.

probes.name: ORF8
probes.note: One of the five genus-specific genes. NC_001958 complement(25201..25698), 165 aa; cluster median 174 aa. Function UNKNOWN -- keeping the number.

probes.name: fiber / sialic acid receptor
probes.note: TAdV-3 binds sialic acid on N-linked membrane glycoproteins of B cells; required for infection. Fibre head is a twisted beta-sandwich binding sialyllactose.

probes.name: 100K / host shut-off
probes.note: SHUTOFF WAS DECLARED AS A SEPARATE FEATURE AND THAT WAS WRONG. The 8 'shutoff protein' deposits are 703 aa and all consolidated into K100 -- the late 100K protein IS the host shut-off protein. Synonym, not a gene. NC_001958 18184..20226, 680 aa.

probes.name: U exon protein
probes.note: Late l-strand product.

probes.name: protein IX
probes.note: ABSENT, and decided. Siadenovirus is the one genus with no pIX; NC_001958 annotates none and the cross-genus capsid-cement comparison says so directly. Not a gap.

Barthadenovirus._comment: BV-BRC's label for ICTV Atadenovirus: duck, ovine and bovine atadenovirus, snake, lizard and bearded dragon adenoviruses.

probes.name: p32K
probes.note: Genus-specific MINOR COAT protein; alpha-helical clusters beneath the capsid facet. OAdV-7 NC_004037 complement(238..1098), 286 aa.

probes.name: LH1
probes.note: NC_004037 1143..1505, 120 aa. No function established -- keeping the number.

probes.name: LH2
probes.note: STRUCTURAL component, previously unrecognised as one: an extended polypeptide driving a large conformational change in vertex protein IIIa relative to mastadenoviruses. NC_004037 1490..1873, 127 aa.

probes.name: LH3 (deposited as 'E1B 55K')
probes.note: CAPSID CEMENTING PROTEIN. Trimeric beta-helix, bacteriophage-tailspike fold; binds the capsid via the same triskelion motif mastadenovirus pIX uses, and mastadenovirus E1B-55K was EXAPTED from it. BOTH reference genomes annotate this locus as 'E1B 55K' (NC_004037 1916..3064, 382 aa; NC_009989 2169..3290, 373 aa) and atadenoviruses have NO E1B region at all. 13 such deposits hit LH3 at 42-77% identity full length.

probes.name: RH1
probes.note: F-BOX PROTEIN. MISSING from the feature set until now -- 7 deposits went to UNASSIGNED. NC_004037 complement(29130..29459), 109 aa.

probes.name: RH2
probes.note: F-BOX PROTEIN. NC_004037 complement(28486..29016), 176 aa. 7 of its 22 deposits had been consolidated away into RH4.

probes.name: RH4
probes.note: F-BOX PROTEIN. NC_004037 complement(27845..>28318), 157 aa.

probes.name: RH5
probes.note: NC_004037 complement(27244..27840), 198 aa. Carries NO F-box note in the reference annotation, unlike RH1/2/4/6. No function established -- keeping the number.

probes.name: RH6
probes.note: F-BOX PROTEIN. MISSING from the feature set until now. NC_004037 complement(26688..27161), 157 aa.

probes.name: E4.1
probes.note: NC_004037 complement(25225..25653), 142 aa. No function established.

probes.name: E4.2
probes.note: Shares a conserved motif with E4.3 and with mastadenovirus E4 34K, per the reference annotation. NC_004037 complement(24563..25225), 220 aa.

probes.name: E4.3
probes.note: Shares a conserved motif with E4.2 and mastadenovirus E4 34K. NC_004037 complement(23853..24566), 237 aa.

probes.name: U exon protein
probes.note: NC_004037 complement(<22106..22266), 54 aa; 'continues upstream, probably spliced'.

probes.name: protein IX
probes.note: ABSENT, and this CORRECTS an earlier note in this file which claimed pIX was present because 'the atadenovirus capsid structure resolved it together with p32K'. It did not. The structure resolves the GENUS-SPECIFIC proteins LH2, p32K and LH3, and its point is that LH3 occupies pIX's structural role. Neither reference genome annotates a pIX.

_comment: NOT BUILDABLE FROM THIS DUMP, and that is a measurement, not an
assumption: there are ZERO mat_peptide features in the four reference
genomes and zero mature-peptide deposits among the 21,947 distinct
sequences. Every deposit named 'protein VIII' is 227 aa, the same as
every deposit named 'pVIII' -- the full-length precursor.
They are built in build_mature.py by applying published adenain
cleavage sites to the precursor collections. The protease cuts at
(M/I/L)XGX-G and (M/I/L)XGG-X.

precursors.note: Cut at BOTH ends. The 11-residue C-terminal pVIc is the protease's own cofactor, which is why this one is not optional.

signal_peptides.note: Cleaved N-terminal signal sequence directing the protein into the ER. The only one in the family. SignalP 6.0 is not installed here; the published cleavage site is the authority anyway.
